from datetime import datetime
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import pandas as pd


def task_func(data):
    df = pd.DataFrame(data).copy()

    def _find_col(columns, target):
        target = target.lower()
        for col in columns:
            if str(col).lower() == target:
                return col
        for col in columns:
            if target in str(col).lower():
                return col
        return None

    def _infer_year(frame):
        now_year = datetime.now().year

        year_col = _find_col(frame.columns, "year")
        if year_col is not None and not frame.empty:
            years = pd.to_numeric(frame[year_col], errors="coerce").dropna()
            if not years.empty:
                return int(years.iloc[0])

        for candidate in ["date", "datetime", "month"]:
            col = _find_col(frame.columns, candidate)
            if col is not None and not frame.empty:
                dt = pd.to_datetime(frame[col], errors="coerce")
                dt = dt.dropna()
                if not dt.empty:
                    return int(dt.iloc[0].year)

        if isinstance(frame.index, pd.DatetimeIndex) and len(frame.index) > 0:
            return int(frame.index[0].year)

        return now_year

    def _month_labels_and_order(month_series):
        month_to_num = {
            "jan": 1, "january": 1,
            "feb": 2, "february": 2,
            "mar": 3, "march": 3,
            "apr": 4, "april": 4,
            "may": 5,
            "jun": 6, "june": 6,
            "jul": 7, "july": 7,
            "aug": 8, "august": 8,
            "sep": 9, "sept": 9, "september": 9,
            "oct": 10, "october": 10,
            "nov": 11, "november": 11,
            "dec": 12, "december": 12,
        }

        numeric = pd.to_numeric(month_series, errors="coerce")
        if numeric.notna().all():
            ordinals = numeric.astype(int)
            if ordinals.between(1, 12).all():
                labels = pd.to_datetime(ordinals, format="%m").dt.strftime("%b")
            else:
                labels = ordinals.astype(str)
            return ordinals, labels

        dt = pd.to_datetime(month_series, errors="coerce")
        if dt.notna().all():
            return dt.dt.month, dt.dt.strftime("%b")

        normalized = month_series.astype(str).str.strip().str.lower()
        mapped = normalized.map(month_to_num)
        if mapped.notna().all():
            ordinals = mapped.astype(int)
            labels = pd.to_datetime(ordinals, format="%m").dt.strftime("%b")
            return ordinals, labels

        return pd.Series(range(len(month_series)), index=month_series.index), month_series.astype(str)

    month_col = _find_col(df.columns, "month")
    value_col = _find_col(df.columns, "value")

    if month_col is None and len(df.columns) >= 1:
        month_col = df.columns[0]
    if value_col is None and len(df.columns) >= 2:
        value_col = df.columns[1]

    year = _infer_year(df)
    fig, ax = plt.subplots()

    if month_col is None or value_col is None or df.empty:
        ax.set_title(f"Monthly Data for {year}")
        ax.set_xlabel("Month")
        ax.set_ylabel("Value")
        return ax

    plot_df = df[[month_col, value_col]].copy()
    plot_df = plot_df.dropna(subset=[month_col, value_col])

    if plot_df.empty:
        ax.set_title(f"Monthly Data for {year}")
        ax.set_xlabel("Month")
        ax.set_ylabel("Value")
        return ax

    plot_df[value_col] = pd.to_numeric(plot_df[value_col], errors="coerce")
    plot_df = plot_df.dropna(subset=[value_col])

    if plot_df.empty:
        ax.set_title(f"Monthly Data for {year}")
        ax.set_xlabel("Month")
        ax.set_ylabel("Value")
        return ax

    month_order, month_labels = _month_labels_and_order(plot_df[month_col])
    plot_df = plot_df.assign(_month_order=month_order.values, _month_label=month_labels.values)
    plot_df = plot_df.sort_values("_month_order")

    x = range(len(plot_df))
    ax.bar(x, plot_df[value_col].values)
    ax.set_xticks(list(x))
    ax.set_xticklabels(plot_df["_month_label"].astype(str).tolist())

    ax.set_title(f"Monthly Data for {year}")
    ax.set_xlabel("Month")
    ax.set_ylabel("Value")

    return ax
